idea-plugin.name: GitLab Pipeline Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
View, trigger, and manage GitLab CI/CD pipelines directly inside IntelliJ IDEA. No need to switch to a browser: browse pipeline status, inspect build logs, and trigger, retry, or cancel pipelines in one place.

Core features

  • Project auto-detection: collects Git remotes of all projects in the current window (including attached modules) and lets you pick a target project from the GitLab group tree (lazy loading on demand)
  • Pipeline list: status / ref / SHA / source / creation time / duration / trigger user, with pagination for older pipelines
  • New pipeline: pick a branch or enter a ref manually, and optionally pass custom CI/CD variables (key=value)
  • Cancel / retry: supported at both pipeline and job level; run when: manual manual jobs
  • Build logs: shown in a ConsoleView with ANSI coloring, dynamic appending, incremental fetching, keyword search and highlight navigation
  • Auto refresh: running pipelines refresh their logs incrementally at a configurable interval
  • Adaptive layout: the tool window splits top/bottom when docked on a side, and switches to left/right when docked at the bottom or top

Compatibility

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 and later
  • GitLab.com and self-hosted GitLab (REST API v4, token needs the api scope)

Source code

  • GitHub
  • Gitee

This plugin is an independently developed open source extension released under the Apache License 2.0. It is not an official JetBrains or GitLab product.

在 IntelliJ IDEA 中直接查看、触发和管理 GitLab CI/CD 流水线， 无需切换浏览器即可完成「查看流水线状态 → 查看构建日志 → 触发 / 重试 / 取消」的完整闭环。

核心功能

  • 项目自动识别：自动收集当前窗口内所有项目（含附加模块）的 Git 远程仓库， 支持按 GitLab 项目组树选择目标项目（按需懒加载）
  • 流水线列表：状态 / Ref / SHA / 来源 / 创建时间 / 耗时 / 触发人，支持分页浏览更早的流水线
  • 新建流水线：选择分支或手动输入 Ref，支持填写自定义 CI/CD 变量（key=value）
  • 取消 / 重试：流水线级与 Job 级均支持；可执行 when: manual 手动作业
  • 构建日志：ConsoleView 展示，ANSI 着色、动态追加、增量拉取，关键字搜索与高亮跳转
  • 自动刷新：运行中的流水线按可配置间隔自动增量刷新日志
  • 布局自适应：工具窗口停靠侧边上下分栏，停靠底部 / 顶部自动切换为左右分栏

兼容性

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 及以上
  • 支持 GitLab.com 与自建 GitLab（REST API v4，令牌需勾选 api 权限）

代码地址

  • GitHub
  • Gitee

本插件为独立开发的开源扩展，基于 Apache License 2.0 发布， 非 JetBrains 或 GitLab 官方产品。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • First stable release
  • View pipelines of multiple GitLab projects: status / ref / duration / trigger user, with pagination
  • Create pipelines (custom CI/CD variables), cancel / retry pipelines and individual jobs, run manual jobs
  • Job build logs: ANSI coloring, incremental refresh, keyword search and highlight navigation
  • Built against IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2, compatible with 2023.1 and later
